note: Front-layer ownership mask for the 2026-09-24 boat master (source/boat-opening-2026-09-24/source/assets/boat.png, 1254x1254), in master pixel coordinates. The top edge follows the NEAR rail cap: traced on gridded crops of the master (stern 0,820 x3; bow 600,660 x2.14), then snapped every 6 px to the cap's first anti-aliased row (the dark-to-bright step in each column's luminance; strong-signal columns only). Across x 440-546, where the thwart meets the rail, the edge follows the rail highlight rather than the thwart. The edge steps up around the near-rail fittings in front of the passengers: the rope-wrapped stern block, the stern cleat post and the bow cleat post. Front = everything below that edge (near hull wall, rail cap, hanging ropes, studs); back = the interior, seats, far rail, far posts, mast, sail, pennant and bow knob. Rasterised with crispEdges so every pixel has one owner. The handoff scene-layout.json frontMask was a starting suggestion only. Bow: the rail top face as it sweeps up to the stem (1083,903)-(1197,805) is front; the stem rope below y 790 is front.
